baseline_patient_rule: at least one of a patient's saved sections has score > 0
restriction_rule: support >= threshold in the named condition and zero supported patients in the other condition
unit: complete sender -> receiver x ligand-receptor feature_id

random_resampling.rule: independently sample one available section uniformly for each patient, with new draws in each repetition

exact_sensitivity: enumerate the full Cartesian product of one-section-per-patient choices; all choices are equally weighted
primary_inference: retain saved estimate, std_error, statistic, p_value, q_value, CI, status and singular; no refitting or new BH
